message.content:
This is a robotic pool cleaner that filters water. CBP rulings on robotic pool cleaners typically classify them under 8421.21 (filtering or purifying machinery for water), specifically 8421.21.0000, rather than as vacuum cleaners (8508) because they use a pump and filter. Some earlier rulings put pool cleaners in 8479.89, but filtering water machinery fits best here. The 2022 HTSUS has 8421.21.00 subdivided as 8421.21.0000 for filtering or purifying machinery for water, with the statistical suffix 8421.21.0000 (some versions list 8421.21.0010 and so on). I will use 8421.21.0000.

{"hts_code": "8421.21.0000", "reason": "The battery-powered submersible robot pumps pool water through internal filter baskets and returns purified water to the pool, so it is filtering or purifying machinery for water under heading 8421, subheading 8421.21."}
